description: This Java class `MonkeyEventQueue` manages a queue of monkey input events for Android testing. It extends LinkedList to hold `MonkeyEvent` objects, supports adding throttling events, and includes logic for randomizing throttle timing.

classes.name: MonkeyEventQueue
classes.description: A queue that stores `MonkeyEvent` instances for Android's monkey testing framework, with support for throttling and randomization.

methods.name: MonkeyEventQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event queue with random number generator, throttle time, and randomization flag.

methods.name: addLast
methods.description: Overrides `LinkedList.add()` to add a `MonkeyEvent`. If the event is throttlable, adds a `MonkeyThrottleEvent` with optional randomization.
